en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a concrete bridge over a calm river or canal. A group of about a dozen people in formal or semi‑formal clothing stand along the parapet, leaning over the balustrade and looking toward the camera. The bridge has simple rectangular openings in the railing and multiple supporting piers, reflected in the water below. Trees and foliage line the riverbanks in the background. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
